rows.commentary: 1.1: Muhammad Shahzad drops his length just enough, allowing Nitish Rana to steer it neatly past the cordon toward the third man boundary.
1.2: Muhammad Shahzad floats one fuller into the arc, and Nitish Rana pushes it cleanly out to deep extra cover to rotate the strike.
1.3: Wide from Muhammad Shahzad to Rahul Tripathi.
1.3: Muhammad Shahzad strikes a crucial blow as Rahul Tripathi departs for nine, offering a safe catch to Abdul Samad in the outfield.
1.4: Muhammad Shahzad strays down the leg side, and Shashank Singh swiftly deflects it fine down to the boundary.
1.5: Muhammad Shahzad serves up a tempting delivery that Shashank Singh launches majestically over the long-on fence for a maximum.
1.6: Muhammad Shahzad pitches it right in the slot, and Shashank Singh powers it straight down the ground with tremendous force for another six.
Shashank Singh is on fire, smashing back-to-back sixes to rocket to sixteen runs off just four balls!
2.1: Nitish Rana does not score off Abbas Afridi.
2.2: Abbas Afridi digs it in short, but Nitish Rana climbs all over it, dispatching the ball over deep backward point for a massive maximum.
2.3: Abbas Afridi attacks the stumps, and Nitish Rana works it away comfortably into the deep mid-wicket pocket for a single.
2.4: Abbas Afridi bowls a wide to Shashank Singh.
2.4: Abbas Afridi oversteps with a wayward delivery that evades everyone, yielding a single off the byes.
2.4: Dot ball from Abbas Afridi to Nitish Rana.
2.5: No-ball from Abbas Afridi to Nitish Rana.
2.5: Dot ball from Abbas Afridi to Nitish Rana.
2.6: Dot ball from Abbas Afridi to Nitish Rana.
1.5: T Natarajan delivers to Khawaja Nafay, who launches it soaring all the way over deep backward point for six.
1.6: T Natarajan angles it in, and Khawaja Nafay sweeps it cleanly away to the backward square leg boundary for four.
2.1: Shashank Singh strikes as Abbas Afridi departs, caught safely by T Natarajan after a brisk 35 off just 8 balls.
2.2: Shashank Singh loops it up, and Abdul Samad works it toward deep mid-wicket to rotate the strike with a single.
2.3: Shashank Singh pitches it up, allowing Khawaja Nafay to loft it powerfully over long-off for a maximum.
2.4: Shashank Singh keeps it tight, and Khawaja Nafay nudges it toward deep backward point for a single run.
2.5: Dot ball from Shashank Singh to Abdul Samad.
2.6: Shashank Singh drifts one too straight, and Abdul Samad punishes it with a massive strike over backward square leg for six.
3.1: Rahul Tewatia drops one in the arc, and Khawaja Nafay launches it high and handsome over long-on for a maximum.
3.2: Rahul Tewatia tosses it up again, and Khawaja Nafay accepts the invitation, sending it soaring straight over long-off for another maximum.
3.3: Dot ball from Rahul Tewatia to Khawaja Nafay.
3.4: Rahul Tewatia has his man as Khawaja Nafay holes out to T Natarajan, concluding a blistering 41 from 12 deliveries.
3.5: Rahul Tewatia strays in line, and Irfan Khan dispatches it ruthlessly over backward square leg for a towering six.
